verified_claims.claim: 本研究核心样本 LRS6 为 CEN.PK2-1C 衍生的 haploid ura3/ura3/leu2 营养缺陷型菌株，含完整 MVA-紫杉烷途径（mvaE/mvaS、crtE、TASY、CYP725A4/CPR、TAT）。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 4 第 2.1 节 Yeast Strains
verified_claims.evidence: LRS6 (MATa, leu2-3, 112::HIS3MX6-GAL1p-ERG19/...;ARS511b::GAL1p-CYP725A4-PGK1t/GAL3p-CPR-ENO2t; RKC3::GAL1p-TAT-CYC1t), as previously described [7,8], originating from CEN.PK2-1C.

verified_claims.claim: MiniBio 500 复现 YPG 培养的最大总紫杉烷滴度为 10.9 mg/L（较前期 [8] 低约 5 倍）。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 6 第 3.1 节 Results
verified_claims.evidence: the maximum total taxane titer was five-fold lower than the previous cultivation [8], at just 10.9 mg/L (Figure 2B).

verified_claims.claim: 2×YP mini-bioreactor 培养将总紫杉烷滴度提升至 108 mg/L，diterpenoid 1/taxadiene/T5αol 分别达 37、22、5 mg/L。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 9 第 3 节 Results
verified_claims.evidence: the total taxane titer improved 5.4-fold to 108 mg/L, as shown in Figure 3D. The maximum titer of the major oxygenated taxane compound, diterpenoid 1 and the critical Taxol intermediates taxadiene and T5αol, were 37, 22 and 5 mg/L (Figure 3D), respectively, 1.9-, 2.2- and 1.6-fold higher than those achieved in the controlled cultivation with the original yeast extract lot [8].

verified_claims.claim: BioLector 14 种 DSD 组合中 medium 1 给出最高 229 ± 6 mg/L；media 11 与 14 分别为 195 ± 26 和 218 ± 32 mg/L。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 11 第 3.4 节 Results
verified_claims.evidence: Of the 14 media combinations tested, medium one presented the highest total taxane titer of 229 ± 6 mg/L. Media combinations 11 and 14 also produced high taxane titers of 195 ± 26 and 218 ± 32 mg/L, respectively.

verified_claims.claim: 1 L BIOSTAT 验证总紫杉烷滴度达 387 ± 6 mg/L（较模型预测上界 283 mg/L 高约 1.7 倍），T5αAc 达 21 ± 0.3 mg/L（相对 [8] 提升约 6 倍）。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 14 第 3 节 Results
verified_claims.evidence: The total taxane titer was 387 ± 6 mg/L, representing a 1.7-fold improvement compared with that predicted by the statistical model (Figure 6). … The desired TAT product, T5αAc, was detected with a maximum titer of 21 ± 0.3 mg/L, representing an almost 6-fold improvement, compared to the previous literature [8].

verified_claims.claim: DSD 模型预测最优：初始酵母提取物 45 g/L、半乳糖 45 g/L、初始 OD600 = 0.74，对应预测 taxane 滴度 232.15 [181.27–283.03] mg/L，综合 desirability = 0.9883。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 12 Figure 6 prediction profiler
